about.description:
genbadge provides a set of command-line utilities to generate badges
(shields.io-style SVGs) for tools that do not provide one out of the box.
It can currently create badges for test reports (from pytest or any other
junit.xml-generating framework), coverage reports (coverage.xml), and
flake8 reports.
about.summary: Generate badges for tools that do not provide one

name: genbadge
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "1.1.3"

package:
  name: genbadge
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/g/genbadge/genbadge-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2292ea9cc20af4463dfde952c6b15544fdab9d6e50945f63a42cc400c521fa74

build:
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=39.2,<82
    - setuptools_scm
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - setuptools >=39.2,<82
    - click >7.0,<8.4.2
    - pillow
    - requests

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - genbadge
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - python -m genbadge.main --help
      - python -m genbadge.main tests --help
      - python -m genbadge.main coverage --help
      - python -m genbadge.main flake8 --help
  # Runs the project's own pytest suite against the installed package.
  # Deselected:
  #  - test_threshold/test_local_remote: default/--webshields hit the real
  #    shields.io API;
  #  - test_genbadge/test_genbadge_red: hardcode expected SVG metrics for
  #    "pillow >= 8.0" that do not seem to match the actual output of any pillow
  #    release.
  #  - test_parse_flake8 and test_any_command's flake8 cases: need the
  #    `flake8_html` module (genbadge's own "flake8" extra), which is not
  #    packaged on conda-forge.
  - script:
      - python -m pytest tests/test_core.py tests/test_readme_common.py
        -k "not test_threshold and not test_local_remote and not test_genbadge
        and not test_parse_flake8 and not (test_any_command and flake8)" -v
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - defusedxml
    files:
      source:
        - tests/

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/smarie/python-genbadge
  summary: Generate badges for tools that do not provide one
  description: |
    genbadge provides a set of command-line utilities to generate badges
    (shields.io-style SVGs) for tools that do not provide one out of the box.
    It can currently create badges for test reports (from pytest or any other
    junit.xml-generating framework), coverage reports (coverage.xml), and
    flake8 reports.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  documentation: https://smarie.github.io/python-genbadge/
  repository: https://github.com/smarie/python-genbadge

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - pb01ka
